events.description: Called with the new position each time another picture comes into view.
events.name: onIndexChange

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The position of the picture in view, for a controlled lightbox; pair it with `onIndexChange`.
props.name: index

props.description: The position shown first, for an uncontrolled lightbox. Defaults to 0.
props.name: defaultIndex

props.description: The viewer's accessible name, for example "Product photos"; defaults to the catalogue's "Image viewer".
props.name: label

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen
